notes: Downloaded 2026-08-24 (public, no access request needed) to ignored data_lock/raw directory; gzip integrity passed; 196,473 rows, matching the source publication's reported CD45+ immune-cell count exactly. Columns include `patients` (7 distinct IDs: s0107/s0115/s0813/s0816/s0920/s1125/s1231 -- one more than the publication's stated "six patients", discrepancy not resolved here), `organs`/`samples` (5 site codes: CCL/CNL/LCL/LNL/PBL) and `patients_organ` (30 distinct patient x site combinations). Site codes decoded by cross-referencing the source publication's methods (Wang et al., Sci Adv 2023, PMID 37327339, section quoted verbatim: "CD45- nonimmune cells and CD45+ immune cells were collected from primary colorectal cancer (CC), adjacent normal colorectal mucosa (CN), liver metastasis (LM), adjacent normal liver tissue (LN), and peripheral blood (PB)"): CC/CN/LC(=LM)/LN/PB tissue codes + L suffix marking the CD45+ immune-sorted fraction. No per-cell treatment/timepoint column exists -- not needed here, since the registry's series-level `treatment_annotation` (CHEMOTHERAPY_AND_OR_RT_PREOPERATIVE, from GEO's own Overall Design field) already applies uniformly to this cohort, unlike GSE178318 which required a treated/treatment-naive split. A `cluster` column also carries author-provided immune cell-type labels (e.g. `B01_plasma_IGKC`, `M02_Mac_CXCL9`, `T01_cycling_TNK`), not independently verified against the publication's cluster count. This confirms patient- and site-level resolution exists in the public metadata; it does not itself confirm target-gene detectability, which requires the separate, larger GSM7058754_immune_counts.txt.gz (213.9 MB, not yet downloaded).

Downloaded 2026-08-24 (public, no access request needed) to ignored data_lock/raw directory; gzip integrity passed; 41,892 rows, matching the source publication's reported CD45- nonimmune-cell count exactly. Columns include `patients` (5 distinct IDs, a subset of the immune file's 7: s0107/s0115/s0813/s0920/s1231), `organs` (2 site codes: CCT/LCT -- CD45- non-immune fraction sorted only from cancer tissue, not from normal/blood sites) and `patients_organ` (10 distinct patient x site combinations, hundreds to low thousands of cells per combination). Same treatment-annotation reasoning as the immune-fraction file above applies. A `cluster` column carries real author-provided cell-type labels matching the publication's own reported cluster counts closely: 11 `Tu0N_*` tumor-cell clusters (publication: "11 tumor cell clusters", exact match), 6 `E0N_*` endothelial clusters (publication: "6 endothelial cell clusters", exact match), 6 `F0N_*` fibroblast clusters observed here vs. the publication's stated 8 (not reconciled -- may reflect a subset or a different aggregation level). If confirmed usable, joining target-gene counts against these source-defined tumor-cell labels would be more informative than rebuilding a fresh EPCAM-only proxy (the method GSE178318's screen had to use because it had no author cell-type annotation) -- not attempted here, no count matrix opened. Confirms the same patient/site resolution for the tumor-epithelial-focused fraction; target-gene detectability still requires the separate GSM7058755_non_immune_counts.txt.gz (86.2 MB, not yet downloaded).
